name: Vearogh the Shambler

abilities.name: Torch Slam
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage and some flame damage over time.

abilities.name: Hammer Slam
abilities.description: Vearogh winds up his hammer hand and slams it down at you, dealing very high physical attack and knocking you down. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Flame Stomp
abilities.description: Vearogh swiftly stomps the ground, causing a flame eruption to trigger beneath you, indicated by a quickly growing circular AoE, dealing very high flame damage.

abilities.name: Flame Chuck
abilities.description: Vearogh ignites his torch hand with his hammer hand to make it light stronger, before throwing a heavy handful of flame forward at you, dealing very high flame damage. This attack has no indicator.

abilities.name: Flame Burst
abilities.description: Vearogh screams out into the arena, causing flames to burst out from his body, causing an initial hit of high flame damage. These flames then form into two tornadoes that quickly swirl around the arena for a long duration, dealing continuous high flame damage when touched by them.

abilities.name: Summon Undead
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, Envervating Thralls will constantly appear in the arena to join the fight. At certain health intervals, necromantic runes will appear in the corner of the arena, releasing Rift Wraiths and Rift Zombies to also come in and assist.

dialogue.trigger: Once you enter the laboratory and interrupt Sister Bani, she will summon Vearogh to deal with you.

related_quests: The Frozen Isle: Brave the island of Icereach and look for survivors.
Pledge: Icereach: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Icereach.
summary: Vearogh the Shambler is a giant Flesh Atronach who is summoned by Sister Bani after you trespass in her laboratory in Icereach. This is the third boss fight of the dungeon.
